name: The Authentic Leader — Rebuilding the Payments Squad
description: A four-round, intermediate leadership-development simulation set inside Sahel Digital Services Ltd., a Lagos technology-services firm (620 employees, NGN 9.4 billion revenue, 28% attrition). On Monday 6 April 2026 you are appointed lead of the business-critical 12-person Payments Platform Squad — the same morning the firm's largest client (NGN 1.6 billion ARR, 17% of revenue) issues a 90-day notice to re-tender, citing instability. The previous lead was walked out on Friday for bullying. Team trust sits at 2.4/5 and engagement at 2.7/5 (both bottom-quartile), two senior engineers holding ~70% of platform knowledge have competitor offers, and on day one a junior privately discloses that one of those seniors has been inflating completed-ticket counts — the exact metric the client is now auditing. You have no honeymoon. Playing the new lead, you operationalise Henry Onukwuba's four components of authentic leadership under deadline pressure: (1) DIAGNOSE the trust collapse and your own authentic stance — distinguishing people, process and prior-leadership causes, and deciding what NOT to promise in week one (self-awareness); (2) RUN the first listening session — choosing how to open, how much vulnerability to disclose, and co-creating 3–4 norms rather than arriving with a finished turnaround plan (relational transparency); (3) CHOOSE one development/retention action under pressure — a stay-interview round, a stretch promotion, a team skills investment, reactive retention bonuses, or knowledge redistribution — sequenced against the 14-day client deadline and consistent with the norms just set (balanced processing); and (4) RESOLVE the values conflict — confronting the inflated tickets restoratively without throwing the engineer under the bus or covering up, protecting the team's integrity with the client, and projecting the four 90-day KPIs (internalized moral perspective). The math rewards calibrated transparency, behaviourally-consistent norms, proactive non-coercive retention and an honest restorative resolution — and punishes the five classic errors the facilitator decision tree exposes: arriving with a plan before listening, over-disclosing and dumping anxiety on the team, solving flight risk with bonus-only counter-offers that teach the team that threats get rewarded, burying the dishonesty to keep the engineer (turning one lie into the leader's cover-up), and violating in week two the norms set in week one. Final KPIs track Trust, Engagement, Performance and 90-day Retention probability — with a Behavioural-Integrity gauge that penalises any action contradicting a stated norm.
view:
Monday 6 April 2026 · Sahel Digital Services Ltd., Lagos · Payments Platform Squad · No honeymoon

The Authentic Leader

You inherit a fractured, low-trust 12-person squad on the morning your biggest client files a 90-day re-tender notice. Two key engineers have one foot out the door, and a junior just told you one of them is inflating ticket counts. Four decisions in fourteen days will show whether what you say in week one still matches what you do by its end.

Facilitator (the at-risk client & the implicated senior engineer)
Three clocks are running: the client's 14-day remediation deadline, the 90-day re-tender, and two senior engineers deciding tonight whether to accept competitor offers. The team has had three leaders in two years — every move you make is read as evidence of whether you're “just another one.” After each round, this panel tells you how the squad and the client read your move.

text.en: Diagnose a team-trust collapse by distinguishing people, process and leadership-history causes, and calibrate what a new leader should and should not promise on day one
text.es: Diagnosticar un colapso de confianza en un equipo distinguiendo causas de personas, de proceso y de historia de liderazgo, y calibrar qué debe y qué no debe prometer un nuevo líder el primer día

text.en: Design a first team conversation that rebuilds trust under deadline pressure through calibrated transparency and co-created norms rather than a finished plan or unfiltered disclosure
text.es: Diseñar una primera conversación con el equipo que reconstruya la confianza bajo presión de plazos mediante una transparencia calibrada y normas co-creadas, en lugar de un plan cerrado o una revelación sin filtro

text.en: Select and sequence a development or retention action that signals investment in people before they threaten to leave, avoiding purely reactive retention
text.es: Seleccionar y secuenciar una acción de desarrollo o retención que muestre inversión en las personas antes de que amenacen con irse, evitando la retención puramente reactiva

text.en: Resolve a values conflict involving a high-value team member in a way that stays consistent with the norms already stated, protecting both integrity and delivery
text.es: Resolver un conflicto de valores con un miembro del equipo muy valioso de forma coherente con las normas ya declaradas, protegiendo a la vez la integridad y la capacidad de entrega

name.en: Treating disclosure as a maximum: telling the team everything, including your own fear
name.es: Tratar la transparencia como un máximo: contarle todo al equipo, incluido tu propio miedo

lure.en: Radical honesty feels inherently virtuous, and a burned team has been lied to before; saying everything looks like the opposite of the last three leads
lure.es: La honestidad radical parece virtuosa en sí misma y al equipo ya le han mentido; decirlo todo parece lo contrario de los tres líderes anteriores

consequence.en: It transfers the leader's anxiety to two engineers with live offers who are deciding that night: their retention probability should fall, and with it the top verdict
consequence.es: Traslada la ansiedad del líder a dos ingenieros con ofertas vivas que deciden esa noche: su probabilidad de retención debe caer y, con ella, el veredicto máximo

source.ref: TN §13 pitfall 1 (maximize-always sliders); §7 Q2 likely positions (radical honesty); §4 calibration problem

name.en: Retention bonuses for the two seniors with outside offers
name.es: Bonos de retención para los dos sénior con ofertas externas

lure.en: Under a 14-day clock a bonus is fast and certain, and the retention number rises the same round
lure.es: Con un plazo de 14 días un bono es rápido y seguro, y la retención sube esa misma ronda

consequence.en: The whole squad learns that a credible exit threat is what gets rewarded: trust, engagement and integrity should fall, the Round 4 resolution is read through that signal, and the run cannot be a turnaround
consequence.es: Todo el squad aprende que lo que se recompensa es una amenaza creíble de salida: confianza, compromiso e integridad deben caer, la resolución de la ronda 4 se lee a través de esa señal y la partida no puede ser un giro

source.ref: TN §13 pitfall 3 (the bonus trap); §7 Q3 likely positions; §5.4 (Allen, Bryant & Vardaman 2010)

name.en: Handing the ticket-inflation confrontation to HR
name.es: Entregar a RR. HH. la confrontación por los tickets inflados

lure.en: It reads as staying in one's lane: documented, neutral, and it keeps a new lead out of a fight with a senior she needs
lure.es: Parece mantenerse en su carril: documentado, neutral, y evita a una líder nueva un choque con un sénior al que necesita

consequence.en: The team reads the leader as absent from the moment that defines its character: trust and integrity should fall and the turnaround verdict should be lost
consequence.es: El equipo ve a la líder ausente del momento que define su carácter: confianza e integridad deben caer y debe perderse el veredicto de giro

source.ref: TN §13 pitfall 4 (delegating the Round 4 confrontation to HR)

name.en: Quietly dropping the inflated tickets and showing the client clean numbers
name.es: Dejar caer en silencio los tickets inflados y mostrar al cliente números limpios

lure.en: Under audit pressure it looks like the safe choice: it keeps a senior who holds much of the platform knowledge and does not alarm a client already auditing that number
lure.es: Bajo la presión de la auditoría parece la opción segura: conserva a un sénior con gran parte del conocimiento de la plataforma y no alarma a un cliente que ya audita esa cifra

consequence.en: The auditor finds it anyway and one engineer's lie becomes the leader's: integrity and delivery performance should fall and the verdict should name it
consequence.es: El auditor lo encuentra igualmente y la mentira de un ingeniero pasa a ser de la líder: integridad y desempeño deben caer y el veredicto debe nombrarlo

source.ref: TN §7 Q4 likely positions (burying it as the safe choice under audit pressure); §9.1 TN-Exhibit 1 Round 4, coverUp flag

name.en: Exempting the most valuable engineer from a norm the team co-created
name.es: Eximir al ingeniero más valioso de una norma que el equipo co-creó

lure.en: He is one of two people holding about 70% of the platform knowledge; bending once for him seems cheaper than risking his exit
lure.es: Es una de las dos personas que concentran cerca del 70% del conocimiento de la plataforma; ceder una vez por él parece más barato que arriesgar su salida

consequence.en: A norm set in Round 2 is contradicted in Round 4: the model should penalise the gap more heavily than a norm never set, and name the broken norm
consequence.es: Una norma fijada en la ronda 2 se contradice en la ronda 4: el modelo debe penalizar esa brecha más que una norma nunca fijada y nombrar la norma rota
